next_step: POC kickoff: ingest 30k historical tickets + map Zendesk fields; security questionnaire answers due 2026-03-17
notes:
Summary: Mid-market SaaS vendor providing a shared inbox & ticketing layer for SMBs. Looking to add generative summarization + deterministic auto-tagging to reduce TTR and automate macros. Primary integration targets: Zendesk (primary), Freshdesk (secondary).

Recent convo highlights:
- 2026-03-01 discovery call (Jordan + Maya): customer wants 1-2 sentence TL;DR + 4 structured tags (intent, product_area, priority_suggestion, escalation_flag). Quoted: "We need reliable tags so macros don't blow up routing."
- 2026-03-05 technical deep-dive (Maya + SEs): shared sample dataset (30k tickets), schema mapping for Zendesk custom fields, decision to try hosted API for speed but with VPC peering option for sensitive queues.
- 2026-03-05 legal/security sync: heavy emphasis on audit trails and KMS; asked about retention controls and model logging.

POC scope (agreed verbally):
- Ingest 30k historical tickets (email+ticket threads) from last 24 months.
- Train/evaluate prompt+few-shot rules for 3 outputs: short summary (1-2 sentences), canonical subject, 4 tags.
- Deliver SDK + sample webhook that writes tags back to Zendesk fields and triggers macros.
- Load test: emulate 500 concurrent agent sessions during marketing spike (approx 200 qps sustained, 500 qps burst). Target: 95% of summaries < 800ms when routed to dedicated pool; fallback to smaller model for bursts.

Integration / product asks:
- Field mapping template for Zendesk: tags -> custom fields, suggested_macro_id, escalation boolean.
- Official support for Freshdesk triggers as alternate route.
- Tool-calling: ability for model to return a macro id + confidence score so orchestration layer can run or surface to agent.
- Prefix caching for repeated threads (recurring customers) to reduce tokens/cost.

Security / compliance notes:
- Must support SSO (SAML) and SCIM for provisioning.
- SOC2 + evidence required before commercial contract.
- KMS integration mandatory for any stored encryption keys.
- Data residency: prefer US-only storage for ticket content; need clarification on hosted API data lifecycle.

Commercial & SLA items:
- Price sensitivity: expect to negotiate tiered ARR around $60k-150k with a 12mo commit for Dedicated.
- SLA requirement: 99.9% uptime for inference endpoints during business hours; explicit handling/rollover for spike overloads (model fallback).

Quotes / soundbites from stakeholders:
- Head of Support (Amira Kaur): "If the tags are wrong, our macros route to the wrong SLAs — can't afford noisy automation."
- Engineering lead (Samir Khan): "We'd prefer a 'cold' hosted start then move to VPC-dedicated once stable. Need a clear migration path."

Technical preferences & constraints:
- Models: open to Llama-derivatives or Redwood-verified open models. Preference for quantized models if latency improves and quality is preserved.
- Routing: want smart routing by ticket priority; low-latency paths for 'live agent assist' queue.
- Observability: token-level cost, per-route latency percentiles, and end-to-end trace for macro execution required.

Recent timeline / activities:
- 2025-11-03: initial inbound demo request (lead from Zendesk webinar).
- 2026-01-20: sales intro, NDA signed.
- 2026-02-14: technical questionnaire submitted.
- 2026-03-01: discovery call.
- 2026-03-05: technical deep dive + dataset handoff.

Next steps (short):
- 2026-03-12: Redwood to send POC plan + estimate (done).
- 2026-03-17: customer to complete security questionnaire and provide SSO metadata.
- 2026-03-24: schedule POC kickoff (30-day scope).

Open blockers:
- Data residency confirmation for hosted API (legal).
- Spike SLA & fallback behavior clarification for Dedicated pricing.
- Example of audit log output (customer wants sample logs showing decisioning + tag provenance).

Action items for AE/SE:
- Jordan: follow up on legal question re data lifecycle, escalate to PS for migration plan.
- Maya (SE): prepare mapping template for Zendesk fields + sample webhook for macro execution.
- Leo (CSM): draft onboarding checklist and retention/monitoring plan for POC.
